This mod is designed for beginner players who have recently started playing Minecraft. 
The purpose of this mod is to allow players to view commands at any time, saving them time.
commands gui starting the beginner
give mod menu 1 commands, more commands the commands menu
give mod menu - j
commands menu - k
Why is our mod important for beginners? This mod teaches new players basic commands, so without using third-party programs, players can view simple commands in Minecraft directly in the game. Additionally, players can quickly memorize commands and write them independently in the game.

[download to Forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/start-command/versions)


📥 Installation Guides   
Start Command is available for multiple mod loaders, but we recommend using Forge for the most simple and lightweight experience. If you are using a third-party launcher, it probably has built-in functionality to automatically install mod loaders. Once you have installed your mod loader, you can simply place Start Command into your mods folder like anything else.
